facts.text: The hotel is spread across five original Georgian townhouses.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is spread across five original Georgian townhouses

facts.text: The guest rooms take their colour palette from 19th-century Scottish landscape paintings.
facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms take their colour palette from 19th-century Scottish landscape paintings: from highland glens to forest ferns and mountain heathers.

facts.text: The rooms use rich tweeds, warm woods and luxurious linens.
facts.excerpt: Rich tweeds, warm woods, and luxurious linens bring that landscape indoors.

facts.text: The hotel is a historic hotel on George Street in Edinburgh.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Edinburgh The George is a historic luxury hotel on George Street, one of Edinburgh's most prestigious addresses

facts.text: The Ferrier Suite is in the original townhouse at 25 George Street, once home to the Ferrier family in the late 1700s.
facts.excerpt: located in the original townhouse at 25 George Street, once home to the Ferrier family in the late 1700s

facts.text: The Somerville Suite is named after Mary Somerville, the Edinburgh-born scientist for whom the word 'scientist' was coined.
facts.excerpt: The Somerville Suite is named in honour of Mary Somerville, the Edinburgh-born scientist and visionary thinker for whom the word 'scientist' was coined.

facts.text: The two-bedroom Somerville Suite has views over George Street, roll-top baths and walk-in showers.
facts.excerpt: When you stay in this two-bedroom suite, you will discover views over George Street, roll-top baths, walk-in showers, Bose speakers, and a complimentary minibar.

facts.text: All suites include access to Club InterContinental, the hotel's lounge with added amenities.
facts.excerpt: All suites include access to Club InterContinental, our excluive lounge with added amenities.

facts.text: The suites are situated within the original 18th-century townhouses.
facts.excerpt: Situated within the original 18th-century townhouses, each suite uniquely reflects the character of the Georgian building

facts.text: Every room includes Byredo luxury toiletries, bathrobes and slippers.
facts.excerpt: Byredo luxury toiletries, bathrobes and slippers

facts.text: Suite guests receive a complimentary minibar, fresh flowers and a Nespresso machine.
facts.excerpt: Suite guests also receive a complimentary minibar, fresh flowers, a Nespresso machine, and exclusive access to Club InterContinental.

facts.text: One Bedroom Suites have separate living areas.
facts.excerpt: One Bedroom Suites with separate living areas
Opened in 1881, Edinburgh’s oldest hotel comprises five Georgian townhouses built in the 18th century

facts.text: The hotel's Georgian townhouses are in Edinburgh's New Town.
facts.excerpt: five Georgian townhouses built in the 18th century in the city’s somewhat-misleading-sounding New Town

facts.text: The Printing Press Bar & Kitchen occupies the former home of the writer Susan Ferrier.
facts.excerpt: The Printing Press Bar & Kitchen occupies the former home of Susan Ferrier, Scotland’s answer to Jane Austen

facts.text: The Printing Press menu includes very local Scottish dishes such as cullen skink and rumbledethumps.
facts.excerpt: cullen skink (smoked haddock soup), whipped Knockraich Farm crowdie (a soft cows’ milk cheese), rumbledethumps (a cabbage and potato side dish)

facts.text: The Scottish National Portrait Gallery is a four-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: you’re only a four-minute walk from the Scottish National Portrait Gallery
